AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Seaside Child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a harbor city where [PAWN_pronoun] could see the beautiful sea and the ships coming and going every day. [PAWN_nameDef] also like to run to the tavern and listen to the sailors inside telling all kinds of interesting stories, and these stories made [PAWN_objective] dream of going sailing in the future as well.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Alchemy Apprentice
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was sent to an alchemist's house as an apprentice when [PAWN_pronoun] was only a few years old. Following [PAWN_possessive] master [PAWN_nameDef] learned a lot about alchemy and herbalism, but too early and too much exposure to toxic alchemy materials also severely damaged [PAWN_possessive] body.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Vagabond Child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: For as long as [PAWN_nameDef] can remember things, [PAWN_possessive] childhood was spent moving from colony to colony with the caravans of a ratkin vagabond Tribe. [PAWN_nameDef]'s childhood was one of uncertainty, but also one of invaluable knowledge gained through constant travel, until one day the wars of the other factions spilled over into their brigade.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Street Vendor
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] started working with [PAWN_possessive] parents at a very young age as a street vendor to earn money for the family, a job that [PAWN_nameDef] continued to do even after [PAWN_possessive] parents passed away. [PAWN_nameDef]'s biggest dream is to set up a permanent store, expand [PAWN_possessive] business and live a better life.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Printing Apprentice
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] went to a printing workshop as an apprentice when [PAWN_pronoun] was a few years old. Despite not having access to a school, there was never a shortage of things with words in the workshop, and with the help of other elderly workers in the workshop, [PAWN_nameDef] still learned a lot of valuable knowledge.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Herbalist Apprentice
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s parents run a village herbalist store, and every day [PAWN_pronoun] also has to perform tasks such as picking herbs or processing them. [PAWN_nameDef]'s parents raised [PAWN_objective] with dedication, hoping that one day [PAWN_pronoun]'d be able to get out of the village and go to a professional school to learn more advanced medical knowledge.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Junkyard Child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is an orphan who lives with a group of stray ratkins in a garbage dump outside the city, earning some meager income by disposing of garbage and recycling usable resources. [PAWN_nameDef] is handy and will take garbage and make little trinkets in [PAWN_possessive] free time to share with the other kids in the dump.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Little Waiter
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] came to work as a waiter in a tavern when [PAWN_pronoun] was still very young. It has to be said that [PAWN_nameDef] does have a lot of potential in this area, often helping the tavern earn more money and adding more tips to [PAWN_possessive] small wallet through [PAWN_possessive] exceptional eloquence.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Little Study Servant
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Sent as a servant to a noble's home when [PAWN_pronoun] was a child, [PAWN_nameDef] was assigned to be a study servant for the noble's children, and was mainly responsible for helping to carry backpacks and prepare books and stationery when they went to school. Even though [PAWN_pronoun] didn't have the opportunity to go to school directly, [PAWN_nameDef] was privy to a lot of knowledge and learned from the other study servants.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Little Newspaper Delivery Worker
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: As the oldest child of [PAWN_possessive] family, [PAWN_nameDef] went to the streets at an early age to help support the family by selling newspapers, often in crowded areas and sometimes on [PAWN_possessive] bicycle to deliver newspapers for the newspaper companies.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Flower Farmer's Child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a family of flower farmers whose specialized in cultivating decorative flowers for the upper class, and [PAWN_nameDef] learned a lot about planting and cultivating flowers from [PAWN_possessive] parents.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Blacksmith Child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a blacksmith's workshop, where [PAWN_pronoun] takes time out of [PAWN_possessive] day to study in forging techniques, in addition to carrying materials and tools for [PAWN_possessive] parents, in private, [PAWN_nameDef] also takes some scrap iron and forges [PAWN_possessive] own gadgets to play with.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Pet Shop Child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a pet store where [PAWN_possessive] parents were staff members specializing in caring for and treating pets for the upper class, and it was only natural that [PAWN_pronoun] had to get involved in the work early on in order to take over. [PAWN_nameDef] has seen everything from small turtles to large thrumbos.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Cooking Worker Child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a cooking workshop that, unlike a restaurant, was primarily responsible for making military rations for the army that could be stored for long periods of time. In addition to hauling ingredients and firewood, [PAWN_nameDef] also had to learn how to cook the kind of mixed rations that mix a variety of ingredients, which isn't that hard - after all, it focuses on shelf life and nutritional value rather than flavor.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Art Apprentice
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: When [PAWN_nameDef] was a few years old, [PAWN_pronoun] was picked up by a master painter who brought [PAWN_objective] to the gallery for art studies. [PAWN_nameDef]'s master specialized in private customized artwork for employers, and in addition to needing to help carry the equipment and mix the paints, [PAWN_nameDef] also had to practice painting every day, which effectively enhanced [PAWN_possessive] artistic skills.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Child on the Boat
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: As a fisherman's child, [PAWN_nameDef] lives on a boat all year round and has to follow [PAWN_possessive] parents on fishing voyages starting at a very young age, which allows [PAWN_objective] to accumulate a lot of skills related to fishing and aquaculture, but years of lonely life at sea have also made [PAWN_objective] withdrawn.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Slave Child of the Pirates
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: When [PAWN_nameDef] was a child, [PAWN_possessive] hometown was raided by space pirates, and [PAWN_pronoun] was captured and made a slave on the pirate ship, often to be used as a sex slave by the pirates. By chance, [PAWN_nameDef] manages to sabotage the ship's oxygen system and create a fire, crashing into the planet in an escape pod before the ship explodes.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Human Child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was orphaned shortly after [PAWN_possessive] birth, but [PAWN_pronoun] was then adopted by a group of human colonists. Despite being surrounded by no others of ratkin kind, [PAWN_nameDef] has led a cozy life in this peaceful colony.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Trainee Knight
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: As the child of a noble, [PAWN_nameDef] was sent to the historic knight school for apprenticeship at an early age. Life at the school is very hard and [PAWN_nameDef] needs to apply as soon as possible and learn basic knightly knowledge such as the ancient Ratkin language, fighting, horsemanship, etiquette, etc., to prepare [PAWN_objective]self to be a good knight in the future.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Hybrid Child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s mother is from the Ratkin Kingdom, while [PAWN_possessive] father is from an upstart colony on the rim world, which has allowed [PAWN_objective] to grow up with a more special and better education than the average ratkins, though the hybrid genes have also resulted in [PAWN_nameDef] being more susceptible to illnesses.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Circus Stunt Apprentice
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] lives in a mediocre ratkin village and wishes to venture out into the world. One day a circus comes to the village for a residency, and [PAWN_pronoun] realizes that this could be the best chance to leave the village. With [PAWN_possessive] good sense of flexibility and balance, cute face, and unpaid odd jobs that last until [PAWN_possessive] official debut, [PAWN_nameDef] manages to impress the head of the circus and becomes an apprentice with the troupe.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Naughty Child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s childhood was filled with mischief, whether it was scaring the king hamster on the road, trashing the berry patch, or pulling other ratkin's ears, [PAWN_nameDef] was often reprimanded by the sisters. Enthusiastic and outgoing, [PAWN_pronoun] has a natural affinity for physical labor, but shies away from studying in a desk.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Little Mechanical Maintenance Worker
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s slim figure and good flexibility have led [PAWN_objective] to be hired by a factory to maintain the factory's massive machinery. [PAWN_nameDef] can climb into troubleshoot and maintain machinery in crevices and maintenance tunnels that are inaccessible to adult ratkins, this job is very dangerous, but pays well enough for [PAWN_nameDef] to supplement [PAWN_possessive] family's income.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Little Wall Painter
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s parents are construction workers, [PAWN_pronoun] lives with them on construction sites all year round, found [PAWN_objective]self a job painting walls to subsidize [PAWN_possessive] family. [PAWN_nameDef] brings [PAWN_possessive] painting tools to the market every day to look for customers. [PAWN_nameDef] has good skills and charges reasonable prices, so many customers are happy to let [PAWN_objective] paint their houses, and sometimes, when the customers allow it, [PAWN_nameDef] will even presents [PAWN_possessive] art talent on the wall.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Pet
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Born in a slave camp, [PAWN_nameDef] was sold at a young age to a human colony to be kept as a pet. In the colony, [PAWN_nameDef] was treated like an animal, sleeping in the barn with animals and eating roughage every day, until one day a group of soldiers arriving in an airdrop pod fell from the sky and smashed the barn's enclosure, allowing [PAWN_nameDef] to escape this hell.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Serf Child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born into serfdom, and like [PAWN_possessive] siblings and parents, [PAWN_pronoun] grew up having to participate in heavy labor to pay for high rents and ransom deeds. This grueling and monotonous life profoundly limits [PAWN_nameDef]'s future, but there is nothing [PAWN_pronoun] can do about it.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Alien Child Soldier
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was captured by humans and became an child soldier, [PAWN_pronoun] was promised a return home after three years of service, [PAWN_nameDef] was trained as a scout due to [PAWN_possessive] small size. Eventually the regime was overthrown in a massive mechanoid all-out attack with rebel raids, and lucky [PAWN_nameDef] didn't even make it out of the training camp to the front lines.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Trainee Demon
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Born as a killing weapon, [PAWN_nameDef]'s thirst for blood and fire is deeply engraved in [PAWN_possessive] genes, and the moment [PAWN_pronoun] shuddered and picked up a gun and shot [PAWN_possessive] friend, [PAWN_pronoun] knew that [PAWN_pronoun] would never be able to escape from the shackles of those genes again.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Abandoned Child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: For reasons unknown, [PAWN_nameDef] was abandoned by [PAWN_possessive] mother in a king hamster nest. Patrolling guardian took [PAWN_nameDef] to the local orphanage, where [PAWN_pronoun] and a group of similarly homeless friends lived happily with only bland vegetable soup and brown bread on the table, and where [PAWN_pronoun] will always remember the gentle sister who took care of [PAWN_objective].

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Abandoned Child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: For reasons unknown, the still-infantile [PAWN_nameDef] was abandoned by [PAWN_possessive] mother in the hamster king's hayloft. Patrolling guardian delivered [PAWN_nameDef] to the local orphanage, but the orphanage was actually a lie, and [PAWN_pronoun] was moved into a secret lab controlled by the kingdom the same night. Because of [PAWN_possessive] young age and the side effects of prolonged biological experimentation, [PAWN_pronoun] is still a blur for the memory of the traumatic experience, leaving only an impression of words such as drugs, genetics, incubators, and ological experiments. [PAWN_nameDef] escaped alive, but not understand why [PAWN_pronoun] was born to endure all of this, and filled with hatred for the world as a result.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Smart Little Ratkin
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is the child of an new middle class family, and will always take notes and study hard in school and memorize the knowledge conferred by the teacher outside of school hours, which will indeed make other parents very envious and jealous, but [PAWN_pronoun] doesn't care about it.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Trainee Sister
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Born in a monastery, and as the product of raped sister, [PAWN_nameDef] grew up with the cold stares and disgust of those around [PAWN_objective], and was considered to be something unclean. But under [PAWN_possessive] mother's tutelage, [PAWN_pronoun] believes that if [PAWN_pronoun] treats others well, [PAWN_objective]self will eventually be treated well.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin New Middle Class Child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s parents made a class leap through business, and were able to afford to give [PAWN_nameDef] a better life. [PAWN_nameDef] grew up with plenty of love from [PAWN_possessive] parents, don't need to find a job in a young age to support the family, and a warm life that was much better than the rest of the ratkins.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Research Child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s talent was recognized by the ratkin research Institute, who brought [PAWN_objective] to the Institute to be educated and nurtured; not only did [PAWN_pronoun] receive an education and privileges that were unimaginable before, but [PAWN_pronoun] was also able to work at the Institute as an odd-job worker to supplement [PAWN_possessive] family's income.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Winery Child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s parents are employees of a winemaking estate, and the winery's good business allows [PAWN_objective] to still make a good living. Although it's still too early for [PAWN_nameDef] to participate in winemaking, [PAWN_pronoun] and the other kids will go out to help tend the vineyards or squeeze juice from the grapes by stomping on them with their feet in a vat.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin the Surviving Child of the Flesh Pit
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.titleShort: the Surviving Child of the Flesh Pit
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] unintentionally fell into a deep pit as a child, only to find an exit and leave days later. [PAWN_pronoun] told the villagers that the pit was filled with strange flesh, but no one believed [PAWN_objective], and soon after, [PAWN_nameDef] moved away from the village with [PAWN_possessive] parents.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin the Surviving Child of the Anomaly
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.titleShort: the Surviving Child of the Anomaly
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s village suffered several consecutive anomalous attacks, [PAWN_possessive] parents, friends, and others [PAWN_pronoun] knew were hunted down by unnamed creatures, and only [PAWN_nameDef] was saved by the militia who came to rescue. And then [PAWN_pronoun] was taken by the Royal Anomaly Institute for a series of studies and training. After the horrific experience, [PAWN_nameDef] became sensitive and silent.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Little Lumberjack
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s family has no fixed place to live, so [PAWN_pronoun] often making their home with [PAWN_possessive] lumberjack parents in logging camps throughout the forests. While [PAWN_possessive] parents are busy felling trees, [PAWN_nameDef] either helps with simple processing work or collects firewood to help build a fire for cooking, and is happiest when [PAWN_possessive] parents return from a hard day's work to join [PAWN_objective].

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Craft Apprentice
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Adopted as an orphan by a craftsman, [PAWN_nameDef] was taught the use of various carpentry tools at a few years old, and was then trained to use a variety of processing tools to create crafts. Despite the mundane hardships of [PAWN_possessive] life, [PAWN_nameDef]'s adoptive family still loved [PAWN_objective] enough and teach [PAWN_objective] their entire body of skills.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Smuggling Child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a border smuggling ring, and as a child, [PAWN_possessive] young age became a unique advantage, as border inspectors rarely bothered to check for small children. As a result, [PAWN_nameDef] occasionally carries contraband, blending in with the flow of people to bring smuggled goods into the Ratkin Kingdom.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Little Farm Handyman
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s family is not serfs, but the financial situation is not much better than that of a serf, so [PAWN_pronoun] also needs to be involved in the labor of the farm early in the morning. Every day [PAWN_nameDef] has to get up early to graze the livestock, pull weeds out of the ground, and deliver grain to the mill...... After completing [PAWN_possessive] day's work [PAWN_pronoun] returns home, eats a hasty dinner, and then lies down to prepare for another equally mechanical and tiring tomorrow.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Electrician Apprentice
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s dexterity to perform a variety of complex tasks led [PAWN_objective] to be picked up by an electrician as an apprentice.[PAWN_nameDef] was trained in a variety of techniques related to electrical engineering and became an accomplished apprentice electrician, who in the beginning was a bit of a scofflaw about the safety measures-until [PAWN_possessive] mentor was electrocuted to a crisp in some non-compliance operation.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Little Runner
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef], like the rest of the street kids, spends [PAWN_possessive] free time either walking the streets in packs, playing in the alleys, or finding odd jobs such as running errands for people to buy things and deliver messages. With [PAWN_possessive] daily errands, [PAWN_nameDef] knows the nooks and crannies of the city like the back of [PAWN_possessive] hand, and [PAWN_possessive] errand business is growing steadily.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Epidemic Child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] suffered from a horrific and monstrous disease as a child that nearly took [PAWN_possessive] life. During the time, [PAWN_possessive] family was banished from the village en masse and forced to wander. Fortunately, it was a doctor among a group of Ratkin wanderers who finally cured [PAWN_nameDef], and with that, they joined the wanderer tribe and began the never-ending journey.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Kind Child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has a cozy and wealthy family, which has contributed to [PAWN_objective] developing a kind heart. Not only is [PAWN_pronoun] extremely kind to the different backgrounds Ratkins, [PAWN_pronoun] also shows great tenderness to the animals around [PAWN_objective]. These qualities make [PAWN_nameDef] a favorite child.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Little Milkman
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has taken a part-time job delivering milk to customers in a milk store to supplement [PAWN_possessive] family's income. [PAWN_pronoun] walks the streets early in the morning to deliver fresh milk to customers and then recycles the used up milk bottles. Sometimes, [PAWN_nameDef], who has no money to buy milk for [PAWN_objective]self, will secretly lick the recycled milk bottles and taste the sweetness that [PAWN_pronoun] usually can't touch.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Little Moneylender
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] has been praised for [PAWN_possessive] smartness since [PAWN_pronoun] was a kid, and after [PAWN_pronoun] starts school and gets [PAWN_possessive] first allowance, [PAWN_pronoun] quickly figures out a better way to use the money than buying snacks. [PAWN_nameDef] starts lending [PAWN_possessive] allowance to other kids and encouraging them to buy their favorite things, then when they're done spending, [PAWN_pronoun] start claiming the principal and the high interest rate. [PAWN_nameDef]'s allowance tripled before [PAWN_possessive] parents found out.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Child from the Rich Family
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a very wealthy family, except that, being neither the eldest nor the brightest child, [PAWN_pronoun] was basically unattached to inheriting the family business. Luckily, [PAWN_possessive] family emphasized education, which gave [PAWN_nameDef] the opportunity to get enough education, and future financial support from [PAWN_possessive] family after become an adult.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Little Slingshot Shooter
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Like most children living in the slums, [PAWN_nameDef] is seldom disciplined by [PAWN_possessive] parents and spends [PAWN_possessive] days idling around with [PAWN_possessive] slingshot, shooting birds and destroying public property for fun. Throughout [PAWN_possessive] days and nights of fun, [PAWN_nameDef]'s skill with the slingshot matures, making [PAWN_objective] an excellent young shooter.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Little Delivery
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: In order to help [PAWN_possessive] parents' restaurant expand its business scope, [PAWN_nameDef] volunteered to undertake the takeout delivery service of the family restaurant. [PAWN_pronoun], who has a pair of good legs, often carries food delivery boxes and traveling across the city at extremely fast speeds. [PAWN_nameDef]'s labor brings good results, and [PAWN_possessive] family's restaurant business is booming with the development of the delivery service.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Scared Child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in an affluent rural area and was once a carefree child, until one day, while venturing into the countryside, [PAWN_pronoun] encountered a "Ratkin" that looked exactly like [PAWN_objective], which frightened [PAWN_objective] so much that [PAWN_pronoun] immediately ran home and told the others. But unfortunately no one believed [PAWN_objective], leaving [PAWN_nameDef] to live in fear every day.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Military Cadet
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: As the child of a military family, [PAWN_nameDef], unlike many Ratkins of [PAWN_possessive] age, did not have the opportunity to have fun, but instead joined a preparatory military school at an early age to be trained for becoming a future officer. the various regimented studies and combat training from a young age effectively honed [PAWN_nameDef]'s personal abilities and made [PAWN_possessive] will stronger.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Little Mushroom Hunter
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: As a way to supplement family's income, searching for mushrooms in the forest is a common part-time job for many Ratkin children. [PAWN_nameDef] has a very good sense of smell, and can pick up the distinctive scent of mushrooms amongst the complex smells of the forest, which allows [PAWN_objective] to always find more mushrooms faster than the other children.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Little Cliff Miner
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: In order to mine the rare minerals found in the cliffs, lighter weight Ratkin children are often hired as cliff miners. [PAWN_nameDef] is one such little miner, using [PAWN_possessive] size and weight to work in a variety of dangerous environments with only the protection of simple ropes in exchange for slightly more than the average child miner's pay.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Little Shoe Shiner
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is an orphan who gets himself a job as a shoe shiner in order to survive in the city, where [PAWN_pronoun] and the other shoe-shine kids set up stalls at the train station or other crowded places, yelling and shouting and shining the shoes of passers-by in order to get a little money for the day's meal.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Plantation Child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef], who has experience in farming, accidentally gets a job growing cash crops on a plantation, but the job is strictly confidential. [PAWN_nameDef] doesn't mind, because [PAWN_pronoun] gets a very good salary, and it doesn't matter whether [PAWN_pronoun] grows "psych-o plant" or "smok-leaf".

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Little Resistance Force Transporter
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Due to the naturally low-threat nature of children, little kids like [PAWN_nameDef] are often used by the resistance force as conduits for information. While their normal roles are those of newskids, delivery person, and vendors. But in secret, [PAWN_nameDef] will conceal objects with messages and information in [PAWN_possessive] cargo, passing harmlessly under the eyes of the police and gendarmes to enable the activities of the resistance's intelligence network.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Little Nursing Home Caregiver
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s parents are both staff members of a nursing home where [PAWN_pronoun] grew up. The caring [PAWN_nameDef] usually chats and plays with the elder Ratkin people here, and the knowledgeable seniors are also happy to teach [PAWN_nameDef] some interesting knowledge.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Bastard
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is the illegitimate kid of a Ratkin noble, and that's all [PAWN_pronoun] knows. Although [PAWN_pronoun] can't be reveal in [PAWN_possessive] identity, the subsidized money from the noble allows [PAWN_nameDef] to live a comfortable life and receive an education that is above the average level of Ratkins.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Descendant of the Declined Noble
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Due to the declining quality of the soil over the years, [PAWN_nameDef]'s family is not as strong as it used to be, although the life of a declined noble is far from being comparable to that of any commoner. But even the young [PAWN_nameDef] can see the crisis situation in the family, and in [PAWN_possessive] heart [PAWN_pronoun] desperately hopes to improve [PAWN_objective]self and revitalize the family's influence in the future.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Child of the Noble
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef]'s mother was a brutal aristocrat. From a young age, [PAWN_nameDef]'s mother told [PAWN_nameDef] that might makes right. This made [PAWN_nameDef] more brutal than his mother. [PAWN_nameDef] hates snow beef.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Street Urchin
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a mouse who doesn't let people worry about him. While the other kids were reading in church or helping their parents, [PAWN_nameDef] would be out on the streets with his friends, mugging other mice. Until one day, [PAWN_nameDef] was mesmerized by a picture he "borrowed" from another mouse, and [PAWN_nameDef] went against the grain, locking himself in his room every day and copying every picture he could find.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Squirrel
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in the dense jungles of the kingdom's interior. [PAWN_nameDef]'s favorite thing to do is to swim with his companions in the ocean of branches and leaf veins. [PAWN_nameDef] believes that the jungle is like a mother to [PAWN_nameDef], nurturing [PAWN_nameDef] while protecting [PAWN_nameDef] in times of danger.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Overachiever
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Due to the high expectations of [PAWN_nameDef]'s family, coupled with the need to balance various social activities alongside academic pursuits, [PAWN_nameDef], despite being a noble Ratkin, is overwhelmed by the pressure from both family and peers.

AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.title: Ratkin Versifier Child
AlienRace.AlienBackstoryDef.description: Since childhood, [PAWN_nameDef] has shown a natural talent for language, often coming up with clever turns of phrase. However, [PAWN_nameDef] was unable to receive an education, and as [PAWN_nameDef] grew older, [PAWN_nameDef] seemed destined to fade into obscurity like other Ratkin. Yet, [PAWN_nameDef], unwilling to give up, still enjoys engaging with others and showcasing [PAWN_nameDef]'s outdated eloquence, though [PAWN_nameDef] often ends up becoming the butt of jokes.
